name: divider
description: A heading or short line with a rule filling the room beside it, for section heads, dates and an "or" between choices.

attributes.name: data-align
attributes.description: Where the text sits. start and end leave one rule, filling the rest.

attributes.name: data-gap
attributes.description: Space either side of the text.

tokens.name: --yeti-divider-line
tokens.description: The rule beside the text, written as a border.

a11y.notes: The rules are decoration and are not read out. Keep the heading level the element would have without them.
